MINUTES
  ADJOURNED JOINT CITY COUNCIL AND PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  APRIL 22, 2025

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

An Adjourned Joint meeting of the City Council and the Planning Commission of the City of
Rolling Hills Estates was called to order by MAYOR STEGURA at 5:00 pm.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, and
  Zerunyan (5:04 pm)

City Council Members Absent:  None

Planning Commissioners Present:  Medawar, Nicklas,  Olson,  Repp-Loadsman,
  Romanelli, Schachter

P&A Commissioners Absent:  Yoo

City Staff Present:  City Manager Greg Grammer
  City Attorney Don Davis
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  Community Development Director Naughton
  City Clerk Lauren Pettit
  Assistant to the City Manager Jessica Slawson
  Senior Planner Whitney Berry

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

NONE.

5.  DISCUSSION ITEMS

A.  NAVIGATING THE LANDSCAPE OF EVOLVING HOUSING-RELATED LAND USE
  LAWS
  LOCATION: CITYWIDE

  Recommendation: That the City Council and Planning Commission receive and file this
  presentation.

Community Development Director Naughton and City Attorney Davis provided a staff report
(as per the agenda material), discussing the following topics:
  - recent housing legislation trends
  - decisions being more closely scrutinized by HCD Enforcement Division
  - the need for findings to be supported by the record
  - hierarchy of Land Use Regulations
  - the role of the Planning Commission
  - California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  - due process, ex parte issues
  - findings, including Commission/Council directed findings
  - conditions of approval
  - recipe for effective review & action
  - making a recommendation to Council

Discussion ensued about the process and sequence of meetings that occurred for the recent
Vestar project, and how the process and timeline could be improved for future projects.

  -  California Housing Law changes in long range planning, regulatory areas and
  administrative areas
  -  trends in the definitions of the burden of proof
  -  Housing Accountability Act
  -  Housing Crisis Act (SB 330)

April 22, 2025
 Discussion ensued about holding a second Joint meeting in the future to finish the planned
presentation as outlined in the staff report and PowerPoint presentation.

6.  ADJOURNMENT

At 6:53 p.m. MAYOR STEGURA adjourned the meeting to the 7:00 p.m. Regular City
Council Meeting.

Lauren Pettit  Debby Stegura
